description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkPromptBuilder class in Swift, verifying various aspects of the prompt building functionality.

classes.name: TalkPromptBuilderTests
classes.description: A test case class for testing the TalkPromptBuilder's prompt construction logic.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesTranscript
methods.description: Verifies that the built prompt includes the transcript text and an introductory line.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesInterruptionLineWhenProvided
methods.description: Checks that the prompt contains an interruption line when an interruption time is provided.

methods.name: testBuildIncludesVoiceDirectiveHintByDefault
methods.description: Ensures that the prompt includes a voice directive hint unless explicitly disabled.

methods.name: testBuildExcludesVoiceDirectiveHintWhenDisabled
methods.description: Verifies that the voice directive hint is omitted when the includeVoiceDirectiveHint parameter is false.
